parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A random variable $X$ has the distribution $\text{Po}(25)$.

Use the normal approximation to the Poisson distribution to find $\text{P}(X > 30)$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A random variable $Y$ has the distribution $\text{B}(100, p)$ where $p < 0.05$.

Use the Poisson approximation to the binomial distribution to write down an expression, in terms of $p$, for $\text{P}(Y < 3)$.
